snippet.title: Bosozoku Hamster | Neon Mountain-Pass Racing in Another World | Official Trailer
snippet.description:

Reincarnated as a bosozoku hamster. Become a racing champion to return home.
Race through neon mountain passes in an isekai hamster racing adventure.
